personality_one_liner: A goofy, high-energy cartoon style with thick black outlines, loud colors, and hard offset shadows that makes the UI feel like physical stickers.

spacing.rule: Maintain chunky, generous spacing to emphasize the cartoon aesthetics. Buttons and cards need padding to breathe within their heavy borders.

dont's: Do not use glass or blur effects. This cartoon style relies entirely on solid colors, thick strokes, and hard offset shadows.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Main menu for starting a run, viewing loadout chips, and accessing the hangar.

states.empty: No saved run - show giant bright 'New Run' primary button
states.error: Failed to load save data - show retry button

screens.layout: Use large prominent buttons, a chunky loadout card with heavily outlined chips for game parameters, and loud typography for the pilot name and run stats.

screens.name: Gameplay HUD
screens.purpose: Live in-game UI overlaying the arena.
screens.layout: Minimal but readable against the dark arena. Pill-shaped thick-bordered HP and XP bars. Big bold wave counter.

screens.name: Level-Up Overlay
screens.purpose: Pause game and present three upgrade cards.
screens.layout: Dark semi-transparent scrim. Three distinct, oversized cards side-by-side (or stacked vertically on narrow screens). Each card has a thick black border, bright solid background color, and large bouncy typography.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design system MUST rely on hard offsets instead of soft drop shadows. Implement shadows by rendering a duplicate solid `#141414` background layer offset by X: 4px, Y: 4px underneath buttons and cards, or use React Native's shadow props strictly with 0 blur radius, 1 opacity, and {width: 4, height: 4} offsets.
ALL interactive elements (buttons, cards, chips) require a solid `borderWidth: 3` and `borderColor: '#141414'`.
Load custom TTF fonts via expo-font from the URLs provided in the guidelines. Apply 'LuckiestGuy' to all headers, level-up text, and scores. Apply 'Sniglet' to body text and smaller UI elements.
Selected loadout chips should have a shadow and bright background. Unselected chips should have a neutral background, retain the thick border, but NO shadow (giving a flat/pressed-in look).
Ensure the `arena` retains its dark tone (`#1C1C1C`) to allow the bright, loud gameplay entities (bullets, enemies, player) to visually pop.
Overlays (Level-Up, Pause) should utilize the `scrim` color for the background to darken the gameplay area while bringing the bright UI cards to the absolute foreground.
Do NOT use any blue, indigo, purple, or orange tones as they are strictly banned by the system rules. Rely entirely on Hot Pink, Electric Lime, Bright Yellow, and high-contrast Black/White.
